cells.gaps: The World Bank's series gives 42.7 per cent for 2024; its January 2025 statement that 75 per cent of rural Cameroonians lack electricity names no year for the figure.
cells.note: The latest figure, the World Bank's January 2025 statement that about 25 per cent of rural Cameroonians have electricity, is below the 27 per cent line, so stage 1. Under message 138 a figure from any source counts, not only the World Bank series.
